findings.requirement: Time-bound the documented December 1–7 campaign without manual cleanup dependence
findings.evidence: Values has freeSongs and flags but no start/end dates. Cached values apply on init; refresh failure keeps them. Cache can remain indefinitely offline. Even successful removal is fetched only on foreground and at most every 6 h. An app left foreground has no campaign-boundary reevaluation.
findings.impact: The promised time-bounded campaign is operationally manual; access can remain beyond its ending. This is an existing documented growth gap, not an Apple-wide requirement for a base tuner app. It is required to implement the requested time-bounded launch campaign if retained.
findings.safe_action: Add a bounded optional date window for campaign grants while retaining explicit permanent freeSongs compatibility. Define the promise as absolute UTC start-inclusive/end-exclusive instants (for example 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z through 2026-12-08T00:00:00Z), and update campaign copy to state UTC; alternatively implement explicitly documented local calendar-day semantics consistently rather than mixing the two. Reject malformed, missing-half, reversed or unbounded supplied windows with no campaign grants. Preserve intentional legacy permanent freeSongs only when no window is supplied. Enforce current-time eligibility on every access-policy read, including cached/offline values; a timer alone is insufficient. Publish changes on foreground, apply and boundary timers so locks, counts, paywall and already visible screens refresh. Keep input/count/bytes bounded; allow the full102-ID campaign.
findings.validation: Pure deterministic clock tests: before start, exact inclusive start, just before exclusive end, exact end, after end, cached offline expiration, malformed/partial/reversed window, permanent no-window backward compatibility, all102 valid IDs and invalid/oversized config. Verify both AppStore.canPlay and default FreeOpenings.current consumers recheck time rather than preserving an expired snapshot. Native checks: foreground/background/long-open-app boundary, song locks, lesson entry, continuation and paywall counts. No runtime outcome is claimed by this audit.
